description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, targeting Basking Broodscale.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Ghave's ability, targeting Basking Broodscale.
Resolve the first Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 for the other Ghave ability.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
